하나의 데이터. 누적하고 소모해 「시뮬레이션 우주: 인지 불가 영역」의: A value you can accumulate or spend to strengthen Support systems in the Simulated Universe: Unknowable Domain.
「시뮬레이션 우주」 탐사 과정에서 획득할 수 있는 독특한 화폐. 시뮬레이: A unique currency obtained through exploring Simulated Universe. Will be cleared after Simulated Universe is restarted.
「시뮬레이션 우주」 보상. 헤르타 상점에서 아이템을 구매할 수 있다: A reward from the Simulated Universe. Can be used to buy items from Herta's Store.
설명하기 어려운 재료. 「시뮬레이션 우주: 황금과 기계」의 스킬 시스템: An indescribable material. Used to unlock abilities in the Simulated Universe: Gold and Gears.
설명하기 어려운 재료. 「차분화 우주」의 스킬 시스템 개방에 사용된다: Indescribable materials used to unlock abilities in the Divergent Universe.
중요한 연구 성과, 「차분화 우주」의 적합 레벨을 올리는 데 사용된다: Important research results. Used to increase the Synchronicity Level in the Divergent Universe.
「화폐 전쟁」 콘텐츠를 통해 획득할 수 있으며, [승진 레벨] 상승에 사: Obtained through Currency Wars gameplay, can be used to increase your "Ascension Level."
「화폐 전쟁」 콘텐츠를 통해 획득할 수 있으며, [우위 선점] 활성화에: Obtained through Currency Wars gameplay, can be used to activate "Advantage Layout."
스타피스 컴퍼니가 고객과 결산을 위해 사용하던 화폐. 오늘날 우주여행에: This currency, used by the Interastral Peace Corporation to settle accounts with its customers, is now widely accepted as the hard currency for space travel.
상점 「광추 박람」에서 보상으로 교환할 수 있다: An afterimage of bygone days, invaluable to the Garden of Recollection.
별의 바다에 떠 있는 희미한 빛의 결정은 오래된 괴수의 꿈을 흔들고 있다: Lights flicking in a sea of stars, stirring the dream of a Leviathan. The past turns into candles that light the darkness ahead.
유성처럼 밤하늘을 가르는 빛나는 돌. 꺼지기 전에 잡아서 물건을 교환하자: A fleeting gleam arrowing across the night sky. Catch it before it's gone. Maybe it can be used to barter?
땅에 떨어진 유광은 응고되어 찬란한 보석이 되었다.\n「그 가치는 여전히: Cold ashes of a shooting star fell from the sky.
땅에 떨어진 유광은 탄식의 잔화가 되었다.\n「이건 불타오른 적이 있기라:
Splendid gems formed when a shooting star fell from the sky.
"Precious things stay precious."
상점 「스타더스트의 선물」에서 보상으로 교환할 수 있다: Used to exchange for rewards at the Gift of Stardust shop.
우주정거장 내부에서 유통되는 암호화폐. 특별 상점에서 상품을 구매할 수: The cryptocurrency circulating internally in the Herta Space Station. Can be used to purchase goods in Special Stores.
벨로보그에서 유통되는 공식 화폐. 특별 상점에서 상품을 구매할 수 있다: The official currency circulating in Belobog. Can be used to purchase goods in Special Stores.
선주 연맹 내부에서 유통되는 「촉」이 단위인 화폐. 특별 상점에서 상품을: The internal currency of the Xianzhou Alliance with strales as its basic monetary unit. Can be used to purchase goods in Special Stores.
「시계공」이 직접 발행한 첫 기념 화폐로 전해진다. 시계 소년 조각상에만: This is said to be a commemorative currency issued personally by the Watchmaker. Can only be used at the Clockie Statue.
티탄도 탐낸다고 전해지는 환상적인 음료. 이걸 창세의 소용돌이에 있는 대: It was said that even Titans covet this ambrosial libation. Cast it into the Tides of the Basin within the Vortex of Genesis.
시간의 질서 밖에 존재하는 액체. 창세의 소용돌이에 있는 대야 속 조수에: A liquid that exists outside temporal order. Cast it into the Tides of the Basin within the Vortex of Genesis.
이상 낙원 내부에서 유통되는 기념 코인. 통칭 「원보」라 불리며, 너굴: A commemorative coin used within Planarcadia, commonly known as "Wishbae." Can be exchanged for rewards at Furbobocom News.

desc_씨앗:
Reproductive unit unique to plants.
Most of them symbolize life, some of them taste pretty good.
desc_가스성 유체:
Is it fog, rain, or wind?
You can't tell if it's still in the container without lifting the lid.
desc_금속:
A substance abundant in planets' crust and the ocean.
Very useful, very handy.
desc_기본 식자재:
Ingredients that keep you fed but taste less than ideal.
Not particularly good, but is edible.
desc_고체 정수:
Compound composed of hydrogen and oxygen, essential to support carbon-based life.
Keeping it in the solid state makes it easy to carry.
desc_플로지스톤:
Particles that form the flame.
Genius Society #2 Harald Punch proved its existence, but #3 Nyul Iman disproved it.
#7 Bohdan overthrew Iman's conclusion and proved it again before getting killed by #4 Polka Kakamond days after announcing Phlogiston's existence.
desc_폐기된 기교 부속품: To a bystander, it's just trash. To a craftsman, it's leftover materials. To a recycler, it's credits. Only skilled artisans who truly understand the art of ingenia can see valuable treasures in what others deem wasteful.
desc_사람 높이의 큰 벼: The robust and bountiful rice ears are astonishingly as tall as a person. In certain agricultural and pastoral delves of Xianzhou, such towering auspicious crops can be found everywhere.
desc_편안함: After a long day of work or school, you savagely dive onto your bed on a Friday night, ready to hide there for the next two days.
desc_꿈의 파편:
Shards like this can be found everywhere throughout Penacony.
They once belonged to broken hearts.
desc_녹슨 톱니바퀴: Gears themselves are not rare, but finding gears that meet the specifications is no easy task. With rapid advancements in technology, these outdated parts are being discarded in large quantities.
desc_단백질 쌀:
Nature's gift to human society, friend of mankind, savior of lives.
Smooth as egg white and full of protein.
desc_번개의 눈:
An electric ball made from captured lightning.
If its balance is tipped by a conductor, it emits a lightning ball.
desc_양자의 물결:
Ripples in the Sea of Quanta.
Although called "ripples," they are in fact the most basic form of energy fluctuation.
desc_허수의 잎:
A leaf of unknown origin.
It doesn't belong to any plant and is more of a representation of something more abstract.
The ancient light nourishes the leaf through its veins, displaying its faded but remnant power.
desc_부속품:
Essential components of all machines with strange shapes and specific functions.
Without them, nothing can be made.
desc_가상 입자:
Tiny particles commonly found in the universe but cannot be observed in theory.
Scientists are good at transforming theories into reality.
desc_화염 깃털:
Warm dark feather with a weak ember at its tip.
Sparks trail the feather as it's waved around.
desc_얼음 코어:
Shattered ice fallen from the stars.
The frosty mist it emits when removed from a specialized canister looks like the breath of wintertime.
desc_바람의 소용돌이:
The eye of the storm remains stagnant.
Even when put in vacuum, the grains involved in the vortex continue to revolve around the eye of the storm.
desc_운철:
Resilient meteoric ironsand.
Its tenacity is far superior to solid boulders.
desc_인연천동: While plants of the Tian Dong genus typically grow on land, Tian Dong plants of Scalegorge Waterscape stand out by extensively inhabiting the coastal areas of the Lunarescent Depths. Although artificial cultivation techniques for Tian Dong have become quite prevalent, there are still many who believe in the superstition that "wild plants have stronger medicinal properties," causing significant trouble for the Pearlkeepers.
desc_옥조 유닛: The most essential component of jade abaci, commonly used in the final step of installation.
desc_약초 추출물: Medicinal herbs are the foundation of Xianzhou's medical practice, and these extracts capture the active ingredients from various herbs, enhancing their medicinal efficacy in leaps and bounds.
desc_허기:
In Penacony, "hunger" is an expensive spice that can make any food in the Dreamscape irresistible.
In the world beyond dreams, "hunger" is the smile on the lips of death.
desc_아득함: I've never been outstanding since I was a kid. I barely met the requirements to get into college, and I barely earned enough credits to obtain my degree. Now, I'm sitting at my desk, contemplating how to explain my understanding of "confusion" to you, but am I really worthy of showering you with my superficial understanding? And do you really need to listen to all this broken gibberish of mine? I don't know the answer.
desc_낡은 어금니: No one knows the origin of this molar. The person selling it claims this extremely anachronistic item was found on the battlefield of the Emperor's War, infused by a bygone era of craftsmanship and defiance now lost in modern times.
desc_풍요의 향기:
Jelly-like substance that contains the power of Abundance.
Firm but not stiff, with notes of fragrance, it fills your heart with hope the moment it touches your fingertip.
Do not ask what it's made of.
desc_공허의 파편:
A chip made of iron that seems to possess the power of Nihility.
It may have been a coin that people use to buy things.
But apparently, as the engravings on it fade away, its value went with them.
desc_보존의 건축 자재:
Construction materials that seem to possess the power of Preservation.
When mixed with water it forms a paste, when exposed to air it turns rock-hard.
Please do not use together with Solid Water.
desc_수렵석:
Small stone with the power of The Hunt.
As if guided by someone's will, it moves by itself towards a certain direction.
Sounds like what a magnet would do? I assure you it is not.
desc_지식의 나무껍질:
Dried tree bark that seems to possess the power of Erudition.
Its creases tell the story of the years passed and the wisdom of nature.
It says a lot more when beaten into pulp used for papermaking.
desc_파멸의 이물질:
Strange matter that seems to possess the power of destruction.
Resembling fire but not quite, it is neither cold nor hot and will damage anything that comes into contact with it for over 12 seconds.
Could be the Antimatter Legion's version of trash.
desc_화합의 점액:
A torus that seems to possess the power of Harmony.
It only has one surface. No matter where you depart, you're destined to not reach your destination.
A tiny complaint would be that it is a bit sticky, as if it does not want to let you go.
desc_용린산호:
At the bottom of Lunarescent Depths, there is a diverse array of nearly a hundred coral species, among which dragon scale coral holds the greatest value. Within the coral skeleton of dragon scale coral, there is a rich concentration of Heavenly East compound. This compound serves as the finest antibiotic in the cosmos and possesses numerous other medicinal properties. Despite almost ten thousand years of efforts, humans have yet to learn how to industrially produce this compound.
In front of the entrance to the Fanghu's Alchemy Commission stands a statue of dragon scale coral.
desc_음향과 분노:
As you may have realized, the majority of sounds in this world are noise, and the majority of words are meaningless combinations.
Don't let these distractions sway your judgment.
desc_서멀 그리스: Heat dissipation is a challenge that all Intellitrons must overcome. Although Intellitrons created using different generations of technology differ significantly in terms of materials and internal structures, traditional physical heat dissipation often remains the most suitable choice for many models.
desc_위상의 불꽃:
Sserkal, #29 of the Genius Society, only lived 29 days by human measures of time. Despite that, she put her short life as a spider to good use, inventing new technologies that would have taken the spider-kind thousands of years to develop. Of all her inventions, the most famous must be the technique known as Phase Change.
What people don't know is that this technique was first applied to experiments with ions. She successfully created Phase Flame, which almost immediately changed to another phase. By the time the Flame returned to the Sserkal Phase, our genius had already passed away. She tried to harness the Flame but had too little time to do so. Thus, the Phase Flame continued to change between phases across different worlds, leaving behind the seeds of flame.
desc_차원수의 잎:
The gravity of the planet Arivanta is not fixed. Rather, it changes all the time according to a Bode plot due to the influence of Arivanta's three moons. Ordinary life forms cannot survive such volatility, so the planet developed its unique eco-system, in which the herbal plant Interdimensional Tree is the most famous.
For plants in a world where gravity is constantly subject to change, their leaves often have a hard time landing on the planet's ancient and solid ground. It is for this reason that the Interdimensional Trees tend to shake off their leaves rather late in the year. To help their leaves land, these trees, in the course of evolution, gave their leaves the ability to conduct fast short-distance warp-jumps towards the ground at frequencies that cannot be observed by naked eyes. Even so, not every leaf gets to land on the ground. Those lucky enough to make it watch others rise into the sky and burn as they are devoured by the atmosphere.
desc_비애의 눈물 결정: A Mourning Actor took a gondola and rowed towards a silent world of barrenness, humming an elegy for civilizations long gone. Not a single soul could be found at the site of the doomsday battlefield, but like nacre, the world that had turned into ashes gave birth to pearls of sorrow. The ghosts of the past condensed into clouds and rained down crystals like teardrops. The Actor held a fine grain of such crystal in hand and immediately heard in a dream the glorious chorus of civilizations at their height — heroes with godly might, starships like towering mountains, the whimper of stars, and the rage of the enemy. The Actor became restless in sleep, dragged into silent dreams.
desc_미토스 매듭: To make the divine revelations of the Mythus even more mysterious, the History Fictionologists whipped up something known as Mythus Knots that contain a blend of rumors, secrets, legends, and myths. Historians would then blend such misinformation into what was supposed to be certain and rigid historical facts, with the aim to bring about a future of uncertainty for the universe. According to the History Fictionologists, the course of history is limited by the "narrative drive" in the minds of its observers. If something can be done to mix myths into facts, the universe will be covered in the "mist of uncertainty," allowing it to escape the calamity that is doomed to happen.
desc_싫증: I'm tired of writing. I'm done with it.
desc_기계 큐브: According to legend, this is the heart of a prominent Intellitron leader, containing the Ultimate Source Code, the essence of all inorganic life. Scholars at the Intelligentsia Guild believe that this code holds the key to unraveling the mysteries of inorganic life.
source_기억의 영역 밈 등 적 드랍: Memory Zone Meme or other enemies

character.ashveil.skills.1.name: Whip That Drives Away Beasts
character.ashveil.skills.1.description: Creates a [Bait] on a single designated enemy and deals Lightning DMG equal to 200% of Ashveil's ATK to the target. If the target is already a [Bait], deals additional Lightning DMG equal to 100% of Ashveil's ATK and recovers 1 Skill Point. While a [Bait] exists on the field, all enemies' DEF is reduced by 40%. If no [Bait] is present, Ashveil immediately designates the enemy with the lowest HP as [Bait]. Only one [Bait] can exist at a time.
character.ashveil.skills.2.name: Endless Feast
character.ashveil.skills.2.description: Designates a single enemy as [Bait], deals Lightning DMG equal to 400% of ATK, and immediately triggers a Follow-up Attack on the [Bait]. Ashveil gains 3 Charge points. If [Indulgence] is 4 stacks or higher, consumes stacks to deal additional DMG. If the target is defeated during this attack, continues attacking other enemies until [Indulgence] is less than 4 stacks.
character.ashveil.skills.3.name: Vengeance to be Paid with Teeth
character.ashveil.skills.3.description: Ashveil starts with 2 Charge points (max 3). When a [Bait] is attacked by an ally, Ashveil recovers 8 Energy and consumes 1 Charge to launch a Follow-up Attack dealing 200% ATK DMG and gaining 2 stacks of [Indulgence] (max 12).
character.ashveil.skills.4.name: Eat, O Abominable Hand
character.ashveil.skills.4.description: Using Technique puts enemies in a Daze state for 10s. Dazed enemies cannot initiate combat. Entering combat with Dazed enemies deals 100% ATK DMG to all enemies and Ashveil gains 1 Charge.
Gains [Indulgence] stacks when using Skill/Ultimate or when enemies are defeated during Follow-up Attacks.
Follow-up Attack DMG increased by 80%, and an additional 10% per [Indulgence] stack.
Allies' CRIT DMG increased by 40%, and Follow-up Attack CRIT DMG increased by an additional 80%.
character.ashveil.eidolons.0.name: Caution, No Outings During Full Moon
character.ashveil.eidolons.0.description: All enemies receive 24% increased DMG. If enemy HP is below 50%, increase to 36%.
character.ashveil.eidolons.1.name: Knock, Only Ridicule in the Room
character.ashveil.eidolons.1.description: [Indulgence] max stacks increased to 18. Recovers 35% of consumed stacks after Ultimate.
character.ashveil.eidolons.2.name: Silence, Different Stories
character.ashveil.eidolons.3.name: Remember, No Need to Chew the Truth
character.ashveil.eidolons.3.description: ATK increased by 40% for 3 turns after Ultimate.
character.ashveil.eidolons.4.name: Reminiscence, Detective and Culprit
character.ashveil.eidolons.5.name: Ending, And Then There Were None
character.ashveil.eidolons.5.description: All enemies' All-Type RES reduced by 20% if [Bait] is present. DMG increased by 4% per [Indulgence] stack (max 30).
character.ashveil.specialTerms.0: [Bait]: Target status designated by Ashveil. Triggers Follow-up Attacks when attacked.
character.ashveil.specialTerms.1: [Indulgence]: Stacks gained by Ashveil. Used for Ultimate additional DMG.
